title: Prince of Persia Classic HD
notes: Reviewed community evidence; not a complete playthrough verification.

reviewedUserReports.notes: On a physical POCO X3 NFC, the main menu, Quickstart, intro and first playable level rendered. A rightward virtual-control touch moved the Prince. Timestamp-checked two-finger movement plus crouch (both press orders) and movement plus jump highlighted both buttons while held and cleared on release. The first level loaded slowly. Combat, save/load, extended play, audio quality and every touch sequence were not verified; the original intermittent sticky-button report is not comprehensively cleared. Partial, not full-game approval.
